name: Jelly Belly Assorted Gourmet Jelly Beans
whyItWorks: Jelly Belly beans use corn syrup, sugar, modified food starch, and natural flavorings. They are fat-free, gluten-free, peanut-free, and dissolve smoothly in the digestive tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew small handfuls slowly. Avoid super-sour flavors if you experience mouth ulcers or acid reflux.
watchOuts: Skip acidic citrus flavors (e.g., Sunkist lemon/lime) if sensitive to citric acid.
